R1.condition: Whole raw token exactly matches a declared dictionary key; no entity substitution, splitting, joining or spelling normalization. ROOT_MATERIAL is a subtype of drug-stock/solid material; OIL_MATERIAL is a subtype of liquid.

R2.name: Clinical topic
R2.condition: A PERSON nominal immediately precedes HEAT_PREDICATE at the start of a currently unbound directive frame.
R2.output: Introduce person P and generic clinical instruction episode A; P is the intended recipient/topic, not heat object.
R2.scope: Typed contiguous pattern; no line boundary supplies an unexpressed person.

R3.name: Prefix property
R3.condition: A property immediately precedes a compatible new material noun inside an unbound argument NP; parent-bound property assignments have priority and are never changed.
R3.output: Attach property to that noun only; cleansing at IT36G003 applies to ROOT at G004.
R3.scope: Immediate typed adjacency; no arbitrary attachment across unknowns.

R4.name: Postfix age property
R4.condition: A new material noun is immediately followed by AGE_PROPERTY.
R4.output: Attach age to the immediately preceding noun; oil-old yields OLD(O), not OLD(R).
R4.scope: Immediate typed adjacency, stops at unknown or another head.

R5.name: Root-in-medium heat frame
R5.condition: HEAT_PREDICATE followed by a solid argument NP and liquid argument NP terminated by MEDIUM_POSTPOSITION.
R5.output: Create generic instruction HEAT(solid, liquid medium); no extraction, separation, filtering, root removal, mixing or purification result.
R5.scope: Contiguous typed atoms, with optional R3/R4 NP modifiers; no unknown skipped.

R6.name: Typed backward reference
R6.condition: A MATERIAL_REFERENCE/STOCK_REFERENCE/LIQUID_REFERENCE occurs after resolved nominal mentions.
R6.output: Choose the most recent compatible resolved material/stock/liquid entity in written order. Unknown tokens never introduce a guessed referent. If no compatible referent is available or an unresolved boundary obstructs scope, return UNBOUND.
R6.scope: Current resolved discourse frame; type restrictions are semantic hypotheses, not spelling laws.

R7.name: Application argument and body-site ownership
R7.condition: APPLICATION_PREDICATE followed by a resolved MATERIAL_REFERENCE and BODY_SITE in a clinical-topic frame.
R7.output: Create generic APPLY(material, site) with topic person as recipient; site owned by that person is a paid default clinical grammar assumption. Material comes from the written reference, not a free placeholder.
R7.scope: Contiguous typed atoms; unresolved person/reference/site prevents complete application graph.

R8.name: Directive order
R8.condition: Two resolved action frames follow under the same clinical topic with no phase marker or unknown between them.
R8.output: Procedure order HEAT before APPLY; neither actual execution nor completion is asserted.
R8.scope: Generic instruction aspect; does not replace parent actual stream episodes/phases.
